jobs.description: About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team Mixpanel's Customer Engineering team is a cross-functional group of highly technical problem solvers focused on driving customer outcomes across the full commercial lifecycle. Customer Engineers are the technical face of Mixpanel in the field — connecting prospect business problems to Mixpanel's technical capabilities, running sharp evaluations, and ensuring every customer who signs has a clear, fast path to value. The team works in close partnership with Account Executives on new business and expansion, and hands off to Delivery Engineers to own technical activation post-sale. About the Role The Customer Engineer owns the pre-sales technical journey — from discovery and technical fit assessment through competitive positioning, demo, and POC. You establish whether Mixpanel is the right technical fit before committing to a proof of concept, and when you do run one, you design it to be immediately actionable by the Delivery Engineer: focus metric defined, data validated, success criteria agreed upon. You also return post-sale for cross-sell and strategic expansion that requires a new technical evaluation. A great CE shows up researched, thinks in outcomes, leaves every interaction with more clarity than they walked in with, and treats handoff quality as a first-class output. Responsibilities Lead technical discovery, establishing the prospect's business challenges, technical environment, and qualification before committing to a POC. Design and deliver tailored, research-backed demos that connect Mixpanel's capabilities to the prospect's specific business outcomes. Establish technical fit — confirm the prospect's stack is a match and scope what a meaningful proof requires before the POC begins. Own competitive technical positioning — be the definitive answer to why Mixpanel over Amplitude, PostHog, and warehouse-native alternatives. Run tightly structured POCs with defined success criteria, a named focus metric, and a handoff package the Delivery Engineer can execute from immediately. Return post-sale for cross-sell and strategic expansion requiring a new technical evaluation on a new surface or product. Partner with Account Executives on deal strategy, technical objection handling, and expansion planning. Stay close to Delivery Engineers to understand production realities — your POCs should reflect what actually works in production. We're Looking For Someone Who Has 2–4+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or a technical pre-sales role at a B2B SaaS company. Technical foundation in data analytics, event tracking, APIs, data warehouses, or adjacent domains. Commercial instinct — you understand that your job is to win deals and you orient your work accordingly. Demonstrated ability to run structured POCs with defined success criteria and measurable outcomes. Clear, compelling communication to technical and non-technical audiences. Competitive knowledge of the analytics landscape, or the ability to build it quickly. jobs.title: Customer Value Architect
jobs.description: About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for. About the Role The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a portion of a defined book of accounts. You'll help own the adoption and value plan for each account: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and supporting the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and start developing a point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who is building the skills to own accounts end to end and is ready to grow into greater independence, with support from your manager and senior teammates. Responsibilities Help own the value plan for accounts in your book, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure. Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most. Support discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into adoption plan updates. Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing adoption evidence that supports both. Help lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how a customer uses Mixpanel. Monitor usage and health signals and support business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early. Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into recommendations for the customer. Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team. Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data. Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what you learn with the broader Customer Value Architects team. We're Looking For Someone Who Has 2 - 4 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience. A track record of building relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams. The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders. Growing experience connecting product usage to customer outcomes and ROI. Comfort supporting adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals. Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots. A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward. Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first, with support from your manager and senior teammates. Bonus Points For Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development. Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity. Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling. #LI-Remote Compensation The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings here . Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. About the Role Not a technical role, despite 'architect' in the title, this is relationship and strategy work, not engineering. Customer success, account management, or consulting backgrounds are a better fit than technical ones. The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who thrives on connecting customers' Mixpanel investment to real business outcomes. You'll be the consultative owner of adoption, value, and AI maturity across a named portfolio of high-value accounts, engaged from onboarding through the full contract lifecycle. You are accountable for the outcome, not the commercial relationship owning the value case and the adoption plan behind it. You will build the executive relationships and strategic plans that make Mixpanel indispensable to how your customers build products. Responsibilities Connect mixpanel to customer value Own our value workstream with customers - understanding the business challenges that led them to buy Mixpanel, how they measure the ROI of their investment, and ensuring that they achieve that ROI by working across the customers’ teams and collaborating internally with other Mixpanel teams. Build and own relationships across business and technical stakeholders, including executive sponsors, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to customers' highest-priority goals. Develop and execute success plans that map customer business objectives to adoption milestones and measurable outcomes. Perform ongoing discovery of the customer’s business priorities, internal toolset, and ongoing business pain – synthesize this information into actions that feed your success plans and share information with internal partners as needed. Operate in lockstep with the AE and renewal team, with clear lanes: you partner with the AE on expansion and growth motions and with the renewal team on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that underpins both. You own the value case; they own the commercial outcome. Own value delivery and product relationship  Lead customer enablement sessions—covering topics like dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling—to grow Mixpanel usage depth and breadth across the customer organization. Proactively monitor product usage and health signals; lead regular business reviews to surface insights, deepen adoption, and surface risk early. Drive customer adoption - both identifying new pockets for Mixpanel usage within an organization and strategies for re-engagement where adoption is low. Identify underutilized features and contracted capabilities, translating them into concrete recommendations that expand customer value. Triage customer product requests and issues - solving their use case questions, basic troubleshooting and escalating as appropriate Own the AI Conversation Assess a customer's AI maturity and advise on their agent and context strategy, this is now a first-class part of the job, not a bonus skill. Fluently use Mixpanel's own AI surface (Mixpanel AI, Mixpanel Agent, Headless, and MCP) to help customers building AI-native workflows on their product data. Use AI as a personal operating habit: a rehearsal partner for executive conversations, a discovery-prep engine and stakeholder sentiment analysis. Be the voice of the customer to cross-functional partners Coordinate across GTM, Product, and Engineering to manage escalations, advocate for customer needs, and bring the right resources to bear. Contribute to team playbooks and best practices that scale impact across the broader CS organization. jobs.title: Director, Internal Analysis
jobs.description: About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team Internal Analysis is the data team at Mixpanel — the team that turns data from every corner of the business into the decisions that shape our product and our growth. They own the full path: from raw data in source systems, through a governed warehouse, to the models, metrics, and insights leaders across the company act on. It's two complementary disciplines under one roof. Our Analytics Engineers own the data end to end — ingesting from source systems, modeling through a medallion architecture on BigQuery, and producing the trusted tables and reporting artifacts the rest of the company runs on. Our Data Scientists build on that foundation, partnering with Product to refine the user experience and with GTM to sharpen how we grow — inspecting signals, running experiments, and surfacing the insights that change what we do next. About the Role You'll lead this team — and help shape Mixpanel's data culture. We're looking for someone who can influence the organization to become more metrics-driven: establishing clear KPIs, helping teams define success upfront, and ensuring analytics and data science are engaged as strategic partners from the start of an initiative, not brought in at the end to validate decisions already made. As we grow the data organization's remit across the company, this role has the scope to establish practices that don't yet exist, KPI ownership, cross-functional operating rhythms, a shared standard for what 'data-driven' means here, and where AI belongs in both how the team works and what the platform delivers. It takes building real trust with cross-functional leaders to make any of it stick. This role reports directly into the executive team, reflecting the strategic priority we're placing on data as a company. The role blends technical leadership, people development, and business judgment. You'll own the technical bar for how we ingest, model, govern, and instrument our data, coach senior ICs through ambiguous questions, and make sure the team's work lands — that the signals we surface actually change what the company does. We're posting this role open to either Senior Manager or Director level, with final leveling based on the candidate's experience and scope. Strong Senior Managers ready for a step-up are encouraged to apply alongside seasoned Director-level candidates. Responsibilities Lead & Develop: Build, coach, and grow a high-performing team of Analytics Engineers and Data Scientists. Invest in their development, hold a high bar for craft, and create an environment where strong technical people do their best work. Shape Our Data Culture: Influence the organization to become more metrics-driven — establishing clear KPIs, helping teams define success upfront, and building the operating rhythms that make analytics a strategic partner from the start rather than an afterthought. Own the Data End to End: Guide the team across the full data lifecycle — ingestion, modeling through our medallion architecture on BigQuery, and production of the trusted tables and reporting artifacts that serve as the company's single source of truth. You'll also help the team apply AI where it strengthens our own product, such as anomaly detection, forecasting, or AI-assisted insight generation, ensuring we're building the capabilities we'd expect any modern data function to have. Partner & Drive Insight: Serve as the senior data partner to leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, CS, and Finance — surfacing the questions that matter, translating them into analytical approaches, and turning findings into clear recommendations. Hold the team to a standard of insight, not just analysis. Raise the Technical Bar: Continue elevating standards for pipeline reliability, SQL, dbt practices, data modeling, experimentation, and statistical rigor. Communicate & Manage Change: Translate company strategy into clear priorities, and guide your team through evolving business needs with clarity. Innovate & Eat Our Own Dog Food: We use Mixpanel to understand Mixpanel. Find new ways to combine our warehouse, product analytics, and experimentation tools to set the example of what data-driven looks like. With a lean team, you'll look for ways AI can extend our capacity, from AI-assisted coding and pipeline development to accelerating analysis, so the team's time goes to judgment and insight, not repetitive work. We're Looking For Someone Who Has progressive experience in data and analytics in a B2B SaaS environment, including 3+ years of people management — ideally across both Analytics Engineering and Data Science. More senior candidates who've led a centralized data function are also encouraged to apply. Is highly effective at driving organizational change — building trust with cross-functional leaders, influencing how teams set and measure goals, and embedding data into how decisions get made. Brings strong technical fluency across the full data stack: ingestion and pipeline orchestration, SQL, dbt, data warehouse design (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar), Python, statistical modeling, experimentation, and forecasting, and experience with AI. Fluency with applying AI in both directions: using AI tools to increase team leverage and velocity, and evaluating where AI-driven capabilities (forecasting, anomaly detection, automated insight surfacing) belong in the product itself. Understands the Data Science craft well enough to coach it — experimentation design, causal inference, and the judgment to know when a sophisticated method is warranted versus when a clear chart will do. Has partnered closely with Product and GTM leaders, with a track record of analytical work that materially changed how a company operates. Demonstrates a "player-coach" mentality — comfortable in a pipeline issue, model review, or SQL deep-dive, but able to step back and lead through others. Communicates complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, including senior leaders. Is a natural mentor and developer of talent, with a history of building inclusive, high-achieving teams. Has direct experience with the modern data stack (BigQuery, dbt, Fivetran, Hex). Bonus Points Experience with Mixpanel or other product analytics tools (Amplitude, Heap, Pendo). Familiarity with experimentation platforms and the operational side of running a healthy A/B testing program. Background in PLG and/or hybrid go-to-market motions. Openness to — or active desire for — being a public-facing voice for the craft: speaking, writing, and shaping best practices for analytics and product analytics across the wider SaaS community. jobs.description: About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team The Revenue Strategy & Operations team at Mixpanel partners with Regional and Global Business Leaders to set and execute revenue strategy across the customer lifecycle. We build the strategy, operational processes, reporting infrastructure, and decision-making frameworks that make our GTM teams successful. About the Role As Senior Customer Strategy & Operations Manager, you’ll be the strategic advisor and operating partner to our VP of Global Customer Success. You’ll own how we understand, retain, and grow our customer base - diagnosing what drives upsell, what predicts churn, and what we need to build to scale the post-sales motion. This isn’t a role where you inherit a clean process and tune it at the margins. You’ll get your hands dirty in customer-level data, design the systems that turn signals into action, and build AI-powered tooling. You’ll work directly with CS leadership day-to-day and feed field-level insight back into the broader Revenue Strategy team and GTM leadership. You bring the structured thinking of a consultant and the bias for action of an operator. You’re equally comfortable in a strategy session with the VP and three layers deep in a SQL query. Responsibilities Customer analysis at the account level. Get hands-on with the data to understand what drives expansion, what predicts churn, and where the highest-leverage interventions live. You’ll connect product usage signals, customer health, and commercial outcomes  and translate the findings into decisions the CS org acts on. Forecasting and pipeline rigor for the post-sales motion. Build and evolve how we forecast GRR, NRR, and expansion pipeline. You’re technical enough to wire up the inputs yourself. The CS operating cadence. Run the rhythm - business reviews, executive deep dives, leadership offsites - and make sure the right questions get asked with the right data behind them. CS systems and tooling. Partner with our systems team on our CS platform and its integrations with Salesforce and our product data. You’ve deployed or deeply operated one of these before and know where the leverage is. AI as a force multiplier. Build skills, agents, and automations that the whole CS org can adopt. Strategic partnership with Global CS leadership.  Act as a true business partner in the room, in the work, jointly owning the outcomes. You’ll also coordinate with peers supporting other functions to make sure the post-sales view connects to the broader GTM picture. We're Looking for Someone Who Has 5+ years operating in Revenue Strategy, Sales Strategy, CS Operations, or Business Operations at a high-growth B2B SaaS company. You’ve deployed, administered, or deeply operated a CSP. You understand health scoring, playbooks, and lifecycle workflows. Strong technical and analytical instincts. You write your own SQL, build your own models, and work directly with operational data.  Enterprise product experience. You’ve worked on a product sold to Enterprise customers.  Structured thinking and commercial judgment. Your work is rigorous, your priorities are clear, and you build for impact. Exceptional communication. You can move from a SQL query to an exec-level recommendation in the same hour. jobs.description: About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team The Proactive Insights team is a newly formed team at the center of Mixpanel's AI-first analytics vision. With a greenfield charter, we're building the intelligent layer that transforms Mixpanel from a tool you query into a partner that works for you. We answer the question every data-driven team asks: "What changed, why, and what should I do about it?" We proactively keep users informed about what matters in their data, delivering the right insights and recommendations at the right time, to the right places, both inside and outside of Mixpanel. Some examples of what we are building: Signals : Statistical analysis that automatically identifies which user behaviors cause downstream business outcomes — such as which actions genuinely improve 30-day retention — using causal inference to move beyond correlation Forecasting : Time-series modeling that projects whether a KPI (e.g. Signups) will hit its goal by end of quarter — including trend decomposition, seasonality adjustment, and confidence bands against a target. Simulation : Causal impact modeling that estimates how moving one metric (e.g. weekly sharing rate) by a given amount will ripple through to downstream KPIs like retention or revenue — giving teams a quantified basis for prioritization Cohort Detection : Automated identification of at-risk user cohorts by finding active users who resemble known churned segments across both behavioral patterns and descriptive characteristics, before they churn. Offline batch survival analysis models that estimate each user's probability of a future outcome (e.g. likelihood to churn or convert within 30 days). About the Role As the first Data Scientist embedded in product engineering, you'll champion integrating cutting-edge data science techniques into Mixpanel's products and serve as a methodological resource for cross-functional teams tackling problems that benefit from deeper DS expertise — such as adaptive experimentation. You won't just advise on Proactive Insights; you'll be the analytical brain driving how Signals, Forecasting, Simulation, Predictions, and Cohort Detection actually work. Your models are the reasoning layer behind an AI system that proactively tells customers what changed, why, and what to do next — and increasingly, the layer behind an agent that acts on their behalf. clustering and behavioral similarity approaches for Cohort Detection that are both statistically sound and interpretable to end users Document methodology clearly — including assumptions, validation approaches, and expected output behavior — so engineers can implement reliably without ambiguity Review and validate that production results match expected statistical behavior, partnering with engineers on edge cases and anomalies Establish rigor around statistical significance, multiple testing correction, and uncertainty quantification so customers can trust what they see Work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, including Finance and Data Science, to ensure analytical outputs are grounded in real business outcomes Communicate findings and methodology clearly to Product and Engineering — translating statistical concepts into plain language We're Looking For Someone Who Has MS or PhD in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent industry experience with demonstrated causal inference expertise 5+ years of experience applying statistical modeling to real-world product or business problems Hands-on causal inference experience — propensity score matching, regression discontinuity, difference-in-differences, or instrumental variables — with the judgment to choose the right method for a given problem Experience with survival analysis or retention modeling (e.g. Cox proportional hazards, Kaplan-Meier) Strong Python fluency across the analytical stack — statsmodels , scikit-learn , pandas , and equivalent About the Team Our Total Rewards team designs and runs the benefits programs that support Mixpanel employees around the world. About the Role As our Global Benefits Manager, you'll own how Mixpanel designs, delivers, and governs benefits programs across every country we operate in. You'll work independently on ambiguous, cross-functional problems, like a new country launch, a plan redesign, or an M&A integration, and turn them into clear, workable plans. People across HR, Finance, Legal, and regional teams will look to you as the person who understands both the details and the bigger picture of how benefits decisions affect our people and our business. Serve as Mixpanel's go-to resource on benefits compliance (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, GDPR, and international equivalents), monitoring regulatory change and assessing its impact. Analyze program cost and utilization data to find savings and inform annual budgeting, then turn findings into clear recommendations for leadership. Build benefits education and self-service resources that make complex programs easy for employees to understand and use. commercial enough to close; your job is not to set meetings Innate sense of urgency and prioritization; fast qualification, clear POV, no committee thinking Exceptional communication skills; creates executive-level deliverables that are outcome-first, data-backed, decision-ready Hands-on experience with AI; you’ve moved beyond chat interfaces and built something, shipped something, or broken something trying. Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes. One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions. You'll decide which partner relationships deserve investment, build the programs behind them, and make the case for tradeoffs when priorities compete. This role owns ambiguous, cross-functional problems: which partners to prioritize, how to localize global programs without losing what makes them work, and how to prove partner marketing's contribution to pipeline. marketing A data-driven approach to proving impact, with comfort speaking to partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline Strong writing and content instincts, with experience drafting co-branded, About the Team The People Operations team owns the systems, processes, and programs that make the employee lifecycle run — from day one through every transition in between. We believe that clean data, simple workflows, and well-designed technology are what let the rest of the People & Talent function do its best work. About the Role We're looking for a People Operations Manager who can look at a messy, ambiguous problem and turn it into a clear plan — then execute it. Day-to-day, you'll own our HR technology stack, lead process transformation across the employee lifecycle, and serve as the go-to partner for Payroll, IT, Legal, and the broader People & Talent team when something needs to be built, fixed, or rethought. You'll work directly with vendors, HRBPs, and leadership to make sure our operations are scalable, compliant, and actually simple to use. In the first year, success means moving us from where we are to where we should be: better-configured systems, documented processes, and a team that trusts what's in our tools. Lead technology deployments, platform conversions, and module rollouts, coordinating across IT, HRIS, and vendor teams. Research and benchmark HR technology trends to build and maintain a People tech roadmap that supports scale. Apply AI and emerging tools to improve how the broader People Operations function works — not just your own workflow. Establish and enforce data governance standards across HR systems to ensure accuracy, consistency, and audit readiness. Design and implement a tiered HR support model with clear ownership, escalation paths, and defined service levels. Map current-state and future-state workflows across People, Payroll, Finance, and IT to reduce manual work and maximize automation. Author and maintain the SOP and documentation library at a function level — consistent, audit-ready, and accessible across the team. Own end-to-end compliance for higher-risk programs including I-9/E-Verify, records retention, and system access auditing. Monitor employment law and data privacy developments and translate changes into compliant system configurations and workflows. Manage relationships with external partners, including EOR providers and software vendors, and lead escalations and accountability conversations directly. Facilitate alignment among diverse stakeholders — from managers to HR leadership — adapting communication style and detail level to the audience. Documented and redesigned people processes across the full employee lifecycle, with a track record of reducing manual steps and improving the experience for employees and operators. Influenced cross-functional partners — in Payroll, Finance, IT, or Legal — to adopt new workflows or ways of working, without direct authority over those teams. Applied structured project management practices to multi-stakeholder initiatives: clear plans, tracked dependencies, proactive risk communication, and executive-ready status updates. Established or enforced data governance standards in HR systems, including data quality audits, mass change approvals, and corrective action with multiple teams. Managed compliance programs (such as I-9/E-Verify, records retention, or data privacy requirements) with a proactive approach — building audits and controls before issues surface. Communicated clearly and directly across levels — from frontline employees to leadership — and adapted the message without losing the substance. jobs.description: About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Information Security Team We believe security isn't just a function—it's a platform for bold ideas. The Information Security Team at Mixpanel is a small, high-impact group committed to building a frictionless security program that serves as a model for our company and the broader industry. This is a team for those who are never satisfied, who dream big, and who have the resilience to see those ideas through. We operate at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, where we are critical partners to every team at Mixpanel. Our work requires a broad, generalist skill set across vulnerability management, threat detection, and access management. We strategically balance necessary compliance work with proactive initiatives, with a constant focus on automation as the path to a more efficient security program. We use our expertise in a variety of well-known security platforms and tools to create seamless, automated processes that empower our peers. We are a lean team by design, and we succeed or fail together, committed to transparent communication and a strong sense of ownership. Responsibilities Domain Ownership: Serve as the domain expert for Detection & Response, integrating telemetry from across our entire ecosystem—including Product, Cloud, Corporate Infrastructure, and Identity—to build a unified, high-fidelity detection and response engine. Technical Project Execution: Translate high-level project requirements and technical scoping documents into actionable milestones, managing task delivery and driving cross-functional results. Architect Modern Detection: Design and implement precise, actionable alerting within Google Security Operations (SIEM/SOAR), treating detections as code and ensuring they scale with our high-volume data ingestion. Combat Modern Threats: Develop specialized detection logic and playbooks to identify and mitigate application-layer abuses, customer account-targeted events (ATO), and sophisticated social engineering. Operational Lead (EMEA): Serve as the primary technical lead for security incidents during EMEA hours, driving investigations, containment efforts, and cross-functional communication. Build Threat Intelligence: Evolve Mixpanel’s threat intelligence program by identifying relevant adversaries and translating tactical intel into proactive SIEM/SOAR logic. Infrastructure Management: Ensure the operational health and telemetry flow of our core security stack—including SentinelOne, GCP ****Security Command Center, and Mimecast Incydr—to maintain continuous visibility and alerting integrity. We're Looking For Someone Who Has Security Engineering Foundations: Experience operating across the core pillars of a modern security program—including Product, Cloud, and Corporate Security. You are comfortable navigating Identity (IAM), threat modeling, and secure code reviews as part of a unified team. Detection & Response Specialization: A deep understanding of the detection-as-code lifecycle. You have experience turning raw telemetry into precise, actionable alerting and building the infrastructure required to defend a high-scale SaaS environment. Operational Execution: The ability to manage a high volume of daily security tasks. You are prepared to handle a diverse range of responsibilities—from triaging vulnerabilities and policy violations to investigating suspicious activity across the entire stack. Cloud Data Proficiency: Proficiency with the Google Cloud Platform ecosystem (specifically Cloud Logging, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub) to build automated security data pipelines and maintain visibility across high-volume environments. Modern Automation & AI: Proficiency in Python to develop automated workflows and integrate security tools via APIs. You are comfortable leveraging AI and LLMs to build autonomous security workflows—such as automated alert enrichment, intelligent incident summarization, and AI-assisted code analysis—to drastically reduce time-to-context. Bonus Points For Threat Intelligence Maturity: Experience evaluating and embedding external intelligence—including dark web monitoring, brand protection, and adversary tactics —into a security program. You know how to identify where a specific intelligence source provides the most defensive value and how to integrate that data into automated workflows. Security Outreach & Mentorship: Experience leading "Security Champions" initiatives or a demonstrated ability to elevate the security IQ of non-security teams. You help others think critically about threat identification and telemetry —explaining the "why" behind visibility requirements when building new features or onboarding third-party vendors. jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive, Select Accounts
jobs.description: About Mixpanel Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com . About the Team Our Select Accounts team owns Mixpanel's most strategic accounts. We're a small group of experienced enterprise sellers who run the full motion: protect the base, expand within it, and open net new logos from a defined target list. We don't split farmers and hunters here — everyone does both, and everyone is measured the same way: deep account relationships, disciplined pipeline, and quarter-over-quarter growth in their book. About the Role You'll own Mixpanel's most complex and highest-value accounts — a mix of existing enterprise customers and net new target logos — running renewal, expansion, and new logo motions in parallel. This is a role for someone who has done this before at scale: you solve ambiguous, multi-year account problems by distilling them into a clear, scalable plan, and you set a standard for how the team approaches account strategy, forecasting, and executive engagement. You'll mentor other Account Executives on deal strategy and multi-threading, and your account plans and playbooks will shape how the broader team operates. In your first 90 days, you'll build a territory plan covering your full account list, map the key relationships and growth opportunities in each account, and present your go-forward strategy to leadership. Responsibilities Build and execute account plans that connect Mixpanel's capabilities to each customer's business priorities, anticipating multi-year account trajectory Develop multi-threaded relationships from the practitioner level through the C-suite, creating durable champions at every layer Run regular business reviews that show what's working and surface the next growth opportunity Forecast accurately and keep pipeline clean in Salesforce — no sandbags, no surprises Identify and close expansion opportunities within your book — new teams, new products, upgraded tiers Prospect and close net new logos from your named target list alongside your existing account motion Run a disciplined sales process using MEDDPICC; qualify hard and close on time Partner with Solutions Engineers on product demonstrations and proofs of concept that accelerate deals Build pipeline across all four sourcing channels: self-generated outbound, BDR, channel partners, and inbound Collaborate with Customer Success to make sure customers realize value after the sale Bring customer and market signals back to Product — you're closest to the problem Set the standard for team playbooks on account planning, forecasting, and executive engagement, and mentor other Account Executives on deal strategy We're Looking For Someone Who Has An extensive track record owning the largest, most complex accounts in an enterprise SaaS book, across renewal, expansion, and net new motions Closed seven-figure-plus deals with sales cycles of 6-12 months or longer Built and sustained relationships at the VP and C-suite level across multiple stakeholder groups Used MEDDPICC as a coaching tool for other reps, not just a personal qualification framework Solved ambiguous, multi-year account problems by building a clear, repeatable plan others can follow Mentored or informally coached other Account Executives on deal strategy or account planning Clear written and verbal communication that makes a complex product story land for any audience, from practitioner to boardroom A track record of improving how a sales team operates — playbooks, processes, or shared standards that outlasted any single deal Willingness to travel up to 25% for on-site customer meetings, QBRs, and field events Bonus Points For Experience selling analytics, data, or other technical products Experience selling to product, engineering, or data teams A history of building sales playbooks or enablement content adopted beyond your own book Familiarity with land-and-expand motions in a product-led or PLG-adjacent business Experience representing a vendor's point of view in executive-level strategic partnerships #LI-Remote Benefits and Perks Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care Mental Wellness Benefit Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays Enhanced Parental Leave Volunteer Time Off Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break *please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* Culture Values Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress. Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes. One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone. Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations. Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star. Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible. Why choose Mixpanel? We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions. Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.
